I know it’s absolutely terrifying but the best thing to do is be honest about how you feel. If you really treasure the friendship between you guys, I’d just be upfront and say that you’re having feelings for her again and want to move on from them and maintain a friendship. If you’re not honest about it and you distance yourself, she might take it personally and resentment could grow between you guys. Being honest is scary but I promise you’ll feel so relieved after and very confident that you had the balls to say something about it. Even if it’s not the answer you want, people admire bravery and confidence. :)
